results.corrected_title: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen, a cheaper Gemini 4 tier
results.corrected_summary: Google published Gemini 4 Hydrogen on 12 November 2026 and began a global rollout. It costs $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens, flat across a 1M-token context window. It scores 51 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at the default high thinking level, against 50 for Gemini 4 Argon, and 54 at the new xhigh level.
key_facts: Pricing: $1.50 per million input tokens and $7.50 per million output tokens, flat across the context window
Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index: 51 at high thinking, 54 at xhigh
Available in the Gemini API, AI Studio, the Gemini app, Google Search, Gemini in Sheets (certain plans) and Antigravity (paid tiers)

results.corrected_title: Norway appoints expert group on AI threats to national security
results.corrected_summary: On 13 November 2026 Minister of Digitalisation and Public Administration Torgeir Micaelsen announced an expert group to assess how AI could threaten national security. It is led by Olav Lysne, professor at OsloMet and director of SimulaMet. Proposals are due 1 March and will feed into the new AI strategy and revised national security strategy, both planned for next year.
key_facts: Announced 13 November 2026 by minister Torgeir Micaelsen
Group considers which AI-driven threats Norway should prioritise
Input to new national AI strategy and revised national security strategy

results.corrected_title: CoreWeave reports Q3 revenue of $3.66bn, up 168%, and raises 2026 guidance
results.corrected_summary: CoreWeave reported Q3 2026 results on 10 November 2026. Revenue was $3.66bn, up 168% year over year and above the $3.55bn analysts expected. It raised 2026 revenue guidance to $13.0-13.3bn and reported a backlog of $132.5bn. The stock rose about 22% on 11 November.
key_facts: Q3 revenue $3.66bn, up 168% y/y, versus consensus $3.55bn
Shares rose 21.9% on 11 November (may be intraday)
